1	-- Sprint 3 Task 1: create_po_from_alerts RPC
2	-- Groups alert item_ids by supplier, creates one draft PO per supplier bucket.
3	-- Idempotency key: (studio_id, md5(sorted_item_ids), hour_bucket) — second call within
4	-- the same UTC hour returns the previously created po_ids without re-inserting.
5	--
6	-- ROLLBACK:
7	--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.create_po_from_alerts(uuid, uuid[]);
8	--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.generate_po_number(uuid);
9	--   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.po_creation_idempotency;
10	
11	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
12	-- 1. Idempotency table
13	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
14	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.po_creation_idempotency (
15	  key        text        PRIMARY KEY,
16	  po_ids     uuid[]      NOT NULL,
17	  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
18	);
19	
20	ALTER TABLE public.po_creation_idempotency ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
21	
22	-- Only SECURITY DEFINER RPCs write here; no app-level access needed.
23	DO $$
24	BEGIN
25	  IF NOT EXISTS (
26	    SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies
27	    WHERE schemaname = 'public'
28	      AND tablename  = 'po_creation_idempotency'
29	      AND policyname = 'no_direct_access_po_idempotency'
30	  ) THEN
31	    EXECUTE $p$
32	      CREATE POLICY "no_direct_access_po_idempotency"
33	        ON public.po_creation_idempotency
34	        FOR ALL
35	        USING (false)
36	        WITH CHECK (false)
37	    $p$;
38	  END IF;
39	END;
40	$$;
41	
42	-- Auto-expire rows older than 2 hours to keep the table lean.
43	-- (Supabase pg_cron is used elsewhere; a simple index + periodic cleanup is enough.)
44	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_po_creation_idempotency_created_at
45	  ON public.po_creation_idempotency (created_at);
46	
47	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
48	-- 2. PO number generator  PO-{YEAR}-{per-studio sequential number}
49	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
50	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.generate_po_number(p_studio_id uuid)
51	RETURNS text
52	LANGUAGE sql
53	VOLATILE
54	SECURITY DEFINER
55	SET search_path = public, pg_temp
56	AS $$
57	  SELECT 'PO-' || EXTRACT(YEAR FROM now())::text || '-'
58	    || LPAD(
59	         (
60	           SELECT COUNT(*) + 1
61	           FROM public.purchase_orders
62	           WHERE studio_id = p_studio_id
63	             AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM now())
64	         )::text,
65	         4,
66	         '0'
67	       );
68	$$;
69	
70	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
71	-- 3. Main RPC
72	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
73	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_po_from_alerts(
74	  p_studio_id uuid,
75	  p_item_ids  uuid[]
76	)
77	RETURNS uuid[]
78	LANGUAGE plpgsql
79	VOLATILE
80	SECURITY DEFINER
81	SET search_path = public, pg_temp
82	AS $$
83	DECLARE
84	  v_sorted_ids      uuid[];
85	  v_idempotency_key text;
86	  v_cached_ids      uuid[];
87	  v_supplier_ids    uuid[];
88	  v_supplier_id     uuid;
89	  v_po_id           uuid;
90	  v_po_ids          uuid[] := '{}';
91	  v_item_id         uuid;
92	  v_qty             numeric;
93	  v_unit_cost       integer;
94	BEGIN
95	  -- ── Auth: caller must be an active member of this studio ──────────────────
96	  IF NOT EXISTS (
97	    SELECT 1 FROM public.studio_members
98	    WHERE user_id   = auth.uid()
99	      AND studio_id = p_studio_id
100	      AND deactivated_at IS NULL
101	  ) THEN
102	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'insufficient_privilege'
103	      USING HINT = 'Caller is not a member of this studio';
104	  END IF;
105	
106	  -- ── Feature gate: inventory is Studio+ ────────────────────────────────────
107	  IF NOT public.studio_has_feature(p_studio_id := p_studio_id, p_feature := 'inventory') THEN
108	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature_not_available'
109	      USING HINT = 'inventory feature requires Studio plan or above';
110	  END IF;
111	
112	  -- ── Idempotency check ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
113	  -- Sort the input array so order doesn't matter.
114	  SELECT ARRAY(SELECT unnest(p_item_ids) ORDER BY 1)
115	    INTO v_sorted_ids;
116	
117	  v_idempotency_key :=
118	    p_studio_id::text || '|'
119	    || md5(array_to_string(v_sorted_ids, ','))
120	    || '|'
121	    || date_trunc('hour', now())::text;
122	
123	  SELECT po_ids INTO v_cached_ids
124	    FROM public.po_creation_idempotency
125	    WHERE key = v_idempotency_key;
126	
127	  IF FOUND THEN
128	    -- Second call within the hour — return existing PO ids.
129	    RETURN v_cached_ids;
130	  END IF;
131	
132	  -- ── Collect distinct supplier_ids for the requested items ─────────────────
133	  SELECT ARRAY(
134	    SELECT DISTINCT i.supplier_id
135	    FROM public.inventory_items i
136	    WHERE i.id        = ANY(p_item_ids)
137	      AND i.studio_id = p_studio_id
138	  )
139	  INTO v_supplier_ids;
140	
141	  -- ── Create one PO per supplier bucket (NULL = unassigned) ─────────────────
142	  FOREACH v_supplier_id IN ARRAY v_supplier_ids
143	  LOOP
144	    -- Insert the PO header.
145	    INSERT INTO public.purchase_orders (
146	      id,
147	      studio_id,
148	      supplier_id,
149	      order_number,
150	      status,
151	      total_cents,
152	      ordered_by,
153	      created_at,
154	      updated_at
155	    )
156	    VALUES (
157	      gen_random_uuid(),
158	      p_studio_id,
159	      v_supplier_id,
160	      public.generate_po_number(p_studio_id),
161	      'draft',
162	      0,              -- updated after lines inserted
163	      auth.uid(),
164	      now(),
165	      now()
166	    )
167	    RETURNING id INTO v_po_id;
168	
169	    -- Insert one line per item in this supplier bucket.
170	    -- total_cents is a generated column on purchase_order_lines — omit from INSERT.
171	    FOR v_item_id, v_qty, v_unit_cost IN
172	      SELECT
173	        i.id,
174	        GREATEST((i.min_threshold * 2) - i.current_stock, 1)::numeric,
175	        COALESCE(i.cost_per_unit_cents, 0)
176	      FROM public.inventory_items i
177	      WHERE i.id          = ANY(p_item_ids)
178	        AND i.studio_id   = p_studio_id
179	        AND (
180	          (v_supplier_id IS NULL     AND i.supplier_id IS NULL)
181	          OR
182	          (v_supplier_id IS NOT NULL AND i.supplier_id = v_supplier_id)
183	        )
184	    LOOP
185	      INSERT INTO public.purchase_order_lines (
186	        id,
187	        studio_id,
188	        purchase_order_id,
189	        item_id,
190	        qty_ordered,
191	        qty_received,
192	        unit_cost_cents,
193	        created_at,
194	        updated_at
195	      )
196	      VALUES (
197	        gen_random_uuid(),
198	        p_studio_id,
199	        v_po_id,
200	        v_item_id,
201	        CEIL(v_qty),
202	        0,
203	        v_unit_cost,
204	        now(),
205	        now()
206	      );
207	    END LOOP;
208	
209	    -- Update PO total from the generated total_cents on lines.
210	    UPDATE public.purchase_orders
211	    SET total_cents = COALESCE(
212	          (SELECT SUM(pol.total_cents)
213	           FROM public.purchase_order_lines pol
214	           WHERE pol.purchase_order_id = v_po_id),
215	          0
216	        ),
217	        updated_at  = now()
218	    WHERE id = v_po_id;
219	
220	    v_po_ids := v_po_ids || v_po_id;
221	  END LOOP;
222	
223	  -- ── Persist idempotency record ────────────────────────────────────────────
224	  INSERT INTO public.po_creation_idempotency (key, po_ids, created_at)
225	  VALUES (v_idempotency_key, v_po_ids, now());
226	
227	  RETURN v_po_ids;
228	END;

33	export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
34	  const ip = getClientIp(request)
35	  const { success } = await authedRatelimit.limit(ip)
36	  if (!success) return new Response('Too many requests', { status: 429 })
37	
38	  const supabase = await createClient()
39	  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
40	  if (!user) return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 })
41	
42	  const { data: member } = await supabase
43	    .from('studio_members')
44	    .select('studio_id, role')
45	    .eq('user_id', user.id)
46	    .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
47	    .limit(1)
48	    .single()
49	  if (!member) return new Response('No studio membership', { status: 403 })
50	
51	  const { data: sub } = await supabase
52	    .from('subscriptions')
53	    .select('plan_tier')
54	    .eq('studio_id', member.studio_id)
55	    .eq('status', 'active')
56	    .maybeSingle()
57	  const plan = (sub?.plan_tier ?? 'solo') as PlanTier
58	  const gate = requireFeature(plan, 'inventory')
59	  if (gate) return gate
60	
61	  const url = new URL(request.url)
62	  const category = url.searchParams.get('category')
63	  const supplier_id = url.searchParams.get('supplier_id')
64	  const stock_status = url.searchParams.get('stock_status')
65	  const location_id = url.searchParams.get('location_id')
66	  const is_active = url.searchParams.get('is_active') !== 'false'
67	  const include = url.searchParams.get('include') // e.g. 'ink_registry'
68	  const sort = url.searchParams.get('sort') // e.g. 'value'
69	  const min_threshold_raw = url.searchParams.get('min_threshold')
70	  const limit_raw = url.searchParams.get('limit')
71	  const limit = limit_raw ? parseInt(limit_raw, 10) : undefined
72	
73	  let query = supabase
74	    .from('inventory_items')
75	    .select('*, suppliers(id, name), locations(id, name)')
76	    .eq('studio_id', member.studio_id)
77	    .eq('is_active', is_active)
78	
79	  if (sort === 'value') {
80	    // Approximate sort by cost descending; client will sort by computed total value
81	    query = query.order('cost_per_unit_cents', { ascending: false })
82	  } else {
83	    query = query.order('name')
84	  }
85	
86	  if (category) query = query.eq('category', category as 'ink' | 'needle' | 'supply' | 'aftercare' | 'equipment' | 'apparel' | 'other')
87	  if (supplier_id) query = query.eq('supplier_id', supplier_id)
88	  if (location_id) query = query.eq('location_id', location_id)
89	  // min_threshold=0 means "items where min_threshold = 0" (for BulkThresholdsDrawer)
90	  if (min_threshold_raw !== null) {
91	    const min_threshold_val = parseInt(min_threshold_raw, 10)
92	    query = query.eq('min_threshold', min_threshold_val)
93	  }
94	  if (limit) query = query.limit(limit)
95	
96	  const { data, error } = await query
97	
98	  if (error) {
99	    logger.error({ err: error }, 'inventory items GET failed')
100	    return Response.json({ error: 'Failed to fetch items' }, { status: 500 })
101	  }
102	
103	  let items = data ?? []
104	
105	  if (stock_status === 'low') {
106	    items = items.filter(
107	      (i) => i.current_stock > 0 && i.current_stock <= i.min_threshold,
108	    )
109	  } else if (stock_status === 'out') {
110	    items = items.filter((i) => i.current_stock <= 0)
111	  }
112	
113	  // Client-side sort by total value when sort=value
114	  if (sort === 'value') {
115	    items = [...items].sort(
116	      (a, b) =>
117	        Number(b.cost_per_unit_cents ?? 0) * Number(b.current_stock) -
118	        Number(a.cost_per_unit_cents ?? 0) * Number(a.current_stock),
119	    )
120	  }
121	
122	  // Parallel-fetch ink_registry rows when requested
123	  if (include?.includes('ink_registry') && items.length > 0) {
124	    const itemIds = items.map((i) => i.id)
125	    const { data: inkRows } = await supabase
126	      .from('studio_ink_registry')
127	      .select('id, item_id, batch_number, manufacture_date, expiry_date, reach_compliant, sds_url, product_code')
128	      .in('item_id', itemIds)
129	      .eq('studio_id', member.studio_id)
130	    // Map most-recent registry row per item
131	    const inkMap = new Map<string, typeof inkRows extends (infer R)[] | null ? R : never>()
132	    for (const row of inkRows ?? []) {
133	      if (row.item_id && !inkMap.has(row.item_id)) {
134	        inkMap.set(row.item_id, row)
135	      }
136	    }
137	    const itemsWithInk = items.map((item) => ({
138	      ...item,
139	      ink_registry: inkMap.get(item.id) ?? null,
140	    }))
141	    return Response.json({ data: itemsWithInk })
142	  }
143	
144	  return Response.json({ data: items })
145	}
